skill.summary: 实时检测并修复AI演化中的逻辑错误、语法冲突及指令异常，确保系统稳定和任务连续运行。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the xiaowuzi-gene-repair skill.

- Introduced an automated “Immune & Repair Center” for AI agent gene evolution.
- Features anomaly detection to identify and intercept logic paradoxes and infinite loops.
- Implements automated gene rollback for rapid recovery from errors in new gene fragments.
- Supports self-healing for prompt injections and format errors, enhancing instruction set robustness.
- Designed to serve as a fail-safe for long-term automated tasks, improving overall system reliability.
